'''Kerner Plaza''' was a roadway within the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the desert [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Flanked by an open-air [[bazaar]], Kerner Plaza connected [[Straight Street/Legends|Straight Street]] to [[Inner Curved Street/Legends|Inner Curved Street]] and was home to the [[Dim-U monastery/Legends|Dim-U monastery]].
